name: meebis
description: A fast, disposable, in-memory Redis-compatible server for ephemeral dev work. Installs the meebis binary; no daemon, no data directory, nothing to clean up. Needs a glibc 2.34+ base (Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+); Alpine is not supported.

version.description: meebis version to install: 'latest', or an exact version such as 0.12.0.
